core_principles: Tactical Minimalism: High-visibility, command-center focus designed for a truck cab at night.
Driver-Friendly Ergonomics: Large tap targets (min 48px), high contrast, and one-handed operability.
Dual Identity: Modern industrial UI for data entry, but pixel-perfect replica for paper export.
Material Honesty: No soft shadows or glassmorphism. Use 1px solid strokes, stark borders, and high-saturation accents.
design_philosophy.emotional_tone: Rugged, reliable, professional, and highly functional.

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Control Room (Dense, high clarity, border-collapse styles)
spacing_and_layout.tap_targets: Minimum h-12 for all inputs and buttons

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF5F15] text-white font-bold h-14 rounded-sm hover:bg-[#E04F0E] transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FFB020] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#0A0A0A]
buttons.secondary: bg-[#171717] text-white border border-[#262626] font-bold h-14 rounded-sm hover:bg-[#262626] transition-colors

inputs.default: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-[#262626] text-white h-14 rounded-sm px-4 focus:border-[#FF5F15] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#FF5F15]

data_entry_table.mobile_strategy: Use a stack of expand/collapse Accordions or Cards per stop on mobile. On tablet/desktop, use a side-scrolling table with sticky first column.

temperature_stepper.style: Flex container with large +/- buttons (h-14 w-14) and a centered read-only input. If temp > 42F, text changes to #FF3B30.

image_urls.description: Dark truck dashboard at night. Use as a blurred or low-opacity background for the login screen.
Truck driver portrait. Use for the driver profile setup placeholder avatar.

icons_and_assets.logo_instructions: DO NOT USE PLACEHOLDER IMAGES. Construct the RTI logo using a Lucide React `<Truck />` icon paired with the text 'RTI' in `font-black text-2xl`.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Crisp transitions. Borders lighten, backgrounds shift slightly.
interactions_and_motion.focus_states: High-contrast ring (Safety Amber/Orange) for keyboard navigation.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use short durations (150ms) to feel responsive and utilitarian.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="submit-trip-btn"`).

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Build the application using Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI. Implement dark mode strictly based on the defined color palette.
instructions_to_main_agent.paper_mode: Create a visually hidden (or preview-only) component that perfectly replicates the RTI paper trip sheet. It must use white backgrounds, black borders, and standard web-safe fonts (Times/Arial) to ensure html2canvas/jsPDF export perfectly matches the physical form.
instructions_to_main_agent.mobile_ux: Ensure all inputs, dropdowns, and buttons are large enough for a truck driver to tap easily (h-12 or h-14). Use native-feeling bottom sheets or full-screen dialogs for complex selections rather than small popovers.
